acceptanceGates.required: Official platform API build for privileged LineageSetupWizard with SettingsLib, setupcompat, setupdesign, Lottie, SystemUISharedLib, Lineage internal and telephony-common. Public SDK core checks alone cannot establish complete app compatibility.
SwitchItem.isChecked and MaterialSwitch.isChecked drive toggle ember. Theme/navigation checked groups drive selection. NextAllowed/enabled, focus/hover and generic loading do not imply on.

Keep wizard scripts/results, restored focus, locale and timezone data, permission/security/touch filtering, telephony/managed-profile/TV conditions, callbacks and settings/overlay operations in their original owners. Execute no setup action during artwork work.
Keep RevealHoleView CLEAR compositing, wallpaper reveal, native animation/swipe/key state machine and alpha punch contract. Do not cover the reveal with opaque decoration.
Inspect actual pinned Glif/Footer/Icon mixin source and partner overlay/theme behavior before binding custom textures or removing tints.
Native inflation/text, large fonts/scrolling, focus/controller, accessibility, rotation/dual display, effective overlays and independent final acceptance. Device explicitly deferred.
